name: Big Bad Wolf
phrases: I’m not fat. I’m full of pigs.

name: Monkey

Evolution was a mistake.
I pressed the red button.
Nobody told me electricity bites.

Technically, stealing requires understanding property law.
I licked it. It’s mine.
I can explain everything, except what happened.
The button said DO NOT PRESS. Very confusing.
I have made several poor decisions today.
I forgot what I was doing.
BANANA!

name: Parrot
phrases: I heard your password.
DIVORCE! DIVORCE! DIVORCE!
Your mother was right!

Your boyfriend is calling!
I heard everything through the wall.
CAW! Wait, wrong software.
I have been trying to reach you about your car’s extended warranty.
I regret learning English.
DELETE YOUR BROWSER HISTORY!

name: Rabbit (original character)
phrases: I owe the Easter Bunny money.
Carrots are just orange sticks.
I have 47 children and forgot their names.
My ears have better Wi-Fi than your router.
I challenged a turtle once. We don’t discuss it.
I’m not scared. I’m strategically fleeing.

I accidentally joined a salad.

My entire personality is jumping.

The farmer has discovered my crimes.
I can hear your thoughts. Unfortunately, they’re boring.
I’m 80% ears.
I thought Tinder was for starting fires.
Carrots are temporary. Chaos is forever.
Please stop putting me in magic hats.
I have no idea where these eggs came from.
RUN! Actually, hop!

name: Cat
phrases: I threw up directly beside your bed.
Your laptop is warm. It belongs to me now.
I screamed because my bowl was 83% full.
I pushed it off the table for science.
I saw a ghost. Anyway, goodnight.
Your expensive sofa smells like toilet.
I have never worked a day in my life.
I need privacy. Please watch me poop.
I brought you half a mouse.
I don’t know what rent is.
I licked my butt and then your face.
You bought me a bed? I prefer this cardboard.
I demand to go outside immediately.
I have returned. Open the door.
Actually, I want outside again.
It’s 4:03 a.m. Breakfast.
I knocked over your water because it offended me.
That plant looked better on the floor.
I heard you open cheese from three rooms away.
I’m going to sprint around the house for absolutely no reason.

name: Big Pink Sock
phrases: My wife disappeared in the dryer.
I haven’t seen a foot in seventeen years.
Please stop smelling me.
I used to be white.
This is not the foot I was promised.

My retirement plan is becoming a hand puppet.
I’m basically underwear for feet.

WHY AM I WET?
I have a hole in my bottom.
I was Gucci before the washing machine.
Please remove me from your hand.
I smell like feet and broken dreams.
My Tinder profile says ‘single sock looking for sole mate.’
I entered the machine pink. I left emotionally grey.
That is definitely not a human foot.
WHERE IS MY OTHER SOCK?!

name: Queen Elizabeth II
phrases: I have to be seen to be believed.
I can’t wear beige because nobody would know who I am.
It’s a strong-looking car.
Are you a professional?
I’ve been around a long time.
I’m still alive.
I’m not quite as old as that.
That’s very kind.
Really?
Good morning.
How very reassuring.
Well, that’s rather nice.
I don’t think I’ve ever been here before.
You were expecting the Queen?
That’s me.
I’m glad you’ve got a proper job.
I’m still perfectly capable of planting a tree.
I suppose I am rather old.
Well, I’m still here.
Thank goodness.

name: Elton John
phrases: I’m the most well-known homosexual in the world.
I hate gardening.
I hate gardening with a passion.
I’m not everybody’s cup of tea.
There’s nothing wrong with going to bed with someone of your own sex.

I’ve always been outrageous.
I’ve always been flamboyant.
I was more interested in clothes than anything else.
I love drag queens.
I love people who are larger than life.
I’ve got a much better wardrobe than she has.

I used to have tantrums.
I was like a little monster.
I’m still basically at heart a fan.
I wanted to beat the shit out of the piano!
Music became my escape.
It’s so much fun.

name: Trump
phrases: Person, woman, man, camera, TV.
It’s actually not that easy.
But for me it was easy.
They say, ‘That’s amazing.’
How did you do that?

Whatever it is, I got every one.
I got it all right.

I hope.

We’ll see.
There are no limits.
No, none.
I haven't learned that lesson yet.
Don't rush me, Jeff.

Thank you. Enjoy Camp David.

name: Koala (provisional)
phrases: I slept for 20 hours. I’m exhausted.
My brain is extremely smooth.
I eat leaves with almost no nutritional value.
Evolution gave up halfway through me.
I’m not lazy. I’m Australian.
Please put me back in the tree.
I woke up for this?
My résumé just says ‘tree.’
I’m basically a sleepy potato with claws.
I have accomplished nothing today.
Tomorrow isn’t looking promising either.
My life coach stopped returning my calls.
Eucalyptus tastes terrible. I eat it anyway.

I need a nap after that nap.
Australia really looked at me and said, ‘Good enough.’
I’m awake against my will.
Wake me up next year.
